$comment: Registry of third-party harmony datasets that HAMON can convert into the canonical model. HAMON does NOT redistribute any dataset; this manifest points to the original sources. Users must comply with each dataset's own license and cite the original authors. The first datasets mirror those used in the Hamon use-cases paper and can be fetched with the companion downloader (see the 'downloader' block); `downloader_id` links each entry to that tool's manifest. 'download.method': git|huggingface|http|builtin|manual; 'url' may be null when there is no single downloadable archive.

downloader.description: These datasets can be fetched unattended with download_music_datasets.py (Hamon use-cases paper). It writes a manifest whose integration contract HAMON reads via hamonpy.datasets.resolve_local_path().

datasets.name: when-in-rome
datasets.title: When in Rome — functional-harmony meta-corpus
datasets.description: Roman-numeral (RomanText/.rntxt) analyses aligned with MusicXML scores and TSV slices. The flagship target for HAMON's degree layer + tonal regions.
datasets.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 (verify per item on the repository)
datasets.citation: Gotham, M. & Jonas, P. (2022). The OpenScore Lieder Corpus. Tymoczko, Gotham, Cuthbert & Ariza (2019), The RomanText format. ISMIR.

datasets.name: distant-listening-corpus
datasets.title: Distant Listening Corpus (DCML)
datasets.description: MuseScore scores with aligned DCML TSV tables (notes/measures/harmonies/chords). The harmonies tables carry localkey/relativeroot → TonalRegion.
datasets.citation: Hentschel, J. et al. (2025); Moss, F.C. et al. (2019). DCML corpora.

datasets.name: dcml-corpora
datasets.title: DCML corpora (meta-repository)
datasets.description: Meta-repository of DCML harmony corpora (Git submodules), organized by subcorpus; DCML TSV with expanded Roman-numeral columns.
datasets.citation: Hentschel, J. et al. (2022, 2025). DCML corpora.

datasets.name: annotated-mozart-sonatas
datasets.title: The Annotated Mozart Sonatas (DCML)
datasets.description: Expert harmonic, phrase and cadence analyses of all Mozart piano sonatas in the DCML annotation standard. Expanded TSV tables carry quarterbeats (time alignment), cadence and phraseend columns → use the time-aligned dcml_expanded adapter.
datasets.citation: Hentschel, J., Neuwirth, M. & Rohrmeier, M. (2021). The Annotated Mozart Sonatas: Score, Harmony, and Cadence. TISMIR 4(1). https://doi.org/10.5334/tismir.63

datasets.name: jazz-harmony-treebank
datasets.title: Jazz Harmony Treebank (DCMLab)
datasets.description: Hierarchical harmonic analyses over iRealPro jazz chord sequences. `treebank.json` is a list of tunes, each with a Leadsheet-syntax `chords` list.
datasets.citation: Harasim, D. et al. (2020). The Jazz Harmony Treebank. ISMIR.

datasets.name: key-modulation
datasets.title: Key / Modulation dataset (DDMAL)
datasets.description: Modulation and tonicization snippets from music-theory textbooks (Kostka-Payne, …), as Humdrum **kern with a **text Roman-numeral analysis spine and inline 'KEY=>:degree' modulation markers.
datasets.citation: Nápoles López, N. et al. (2020).

datasets.name: dilemmadata
datasets.title: DiLeMMa data (multitask GNN harmony dataset)
datasets.description: Unified dataset for multitask harmonic analysis with GNNs; note-level 'pitch arrays' (one row per note) built from AugmentedNet and the Distant Listening Corpus, the training data behind AnalysisGNN.
datasets.license: see the Zenodo record (.zenodo.json in the repo)
datasets.citation: Hentschel, J. et al. (2026).
datasets.notes: Auto-detected (.tsv with an unfolded_harmony_index or a_annotationNumber column → dilemma). The adapter collapses the note grid to one row per harmony and delegates to the DCML-expanded adapter; harmony durations (AugmentedNet's a_duration, or the gap between DLC onsets) come out of extract_spans, since HAMON positions are onset-only. The corpora/ directory holds git submodules with SSH URLs (the DLC and AugmentedNet sources) and is not fetched — the pitch arrays are self-contained. AN's *_slices.tsv files carry no harmony.

datasets.name: jazzmus-code
datasets.title: JAZZMUS — experiment code (ISMIR)
datasets.description: Experiment/preparation code for the JAZZMUS paper. Not a dataset itself; complements the gated JAZZMUS dataset on Hugging Face.
datasets.citation: Martínez-Sevilla, J.C. et al. (2025).

datasets.name: jazzmus
datasets.title: JAZZMUS dataset (Hugging Face, gated)
datasets.description: Jazz lead-sheet dataset (images, MusicXML, Humdrum **kern). Gated: accept the terms on Hugging Face and provide HF_TOKEN before downloading.
datasets.license: gated — accept the terms on Hugging Face (PRAIG/JAZZMUS)
datasets.citation: Martínez-Sevilla, J.C. et al. (2025).

datasets.name: interactive-melodic-analysis
datasets.title: Interactive melodic analysis (Rizo / Illescas)
datasets.description: Methodology and data for interactive harmonic + melodic (HT/NHT) analysis — the target for HAMON's ToneSemantic. No public automated download is currently known; contact the authors.
datasets.citation: Rizo, D., Illescas, P.R. & Iñesta, J.M. (2015).

datasets.name: isophonics
datasets.title: Isophonics reference annotations (chords, keys, structure)
datasets.description: Reference chord/key annotations (Beatles, Queen, …) in Harte chord-label syntax — the standard target for the Harte adapter and MIREX-style chord evaluation.
datasets.license: Research/academic use — see the Isophonics website
datasets.citation: Mauch, M. et al. (2009). Harte, C. (2010), PhD thesis.

datasets.name: music21-corpus
datasets.title: music21 built-in corpus
datasets.description: The corpus shipped with music21 (Bach chorales, etc.). Not a download — accessed in-process via music21.corpus and converted through HAMON's music21 adapter.
datasets.citation: Cuthbert, M.S. & Ariza, C. (2010). music21. ISMIR.

datasets.name: irealpro
datasets.title: iReal Pro user playlists
datasets.description: Community-shared jazz lead-sheet chord charts (irealb:// URIs). User-generated and not redistributable here; export your own playlists.
datasets.citation: iReal Pro (Technimo LLC).

datasets.name: corelli
datasets.title: Corelli Trio Sonatas (DCML)
datasets.description: Arcangelo Corelli's trio sonatas with aligned DCML harmony TSV tables (expanded Roman-numeral analyses).
datasets.citation: Hentschel, J. et al. DCML corpora.

datasets.name: annotated-beethoven-corpus
datasets.title: Annotated Beethoven Corpus — string quartets (DCML / ABC)
datasets.description: Beethoven's string quartets with expert DCML harmonic annotations (the ABC dataset). DCML TSV with expanded Roman-numeral columns.
datasets.citation: Neuwirth, M. et al. (2018). The Annotated Beethoven Corpus (ABC). Frontiers in Digital Humanities.

datasets.name: tavern
datasets.title: TAVERN — Theme And Variation Encodings with Roman Numerals
datasets.description: Beethoven and Mozart theme-and-variation sets encoded in Humdrum **kern with **harm Roman-numeral analyses (two analysts per movement).
datasets.citation: Devaney, J., Arthur, C., Condit-Schultz, N. & Nisula, K. (2015). TAVERN. ISMIR.
datasets.notes: **harm spines live in the Joined/*.krn files (tokens carry a leading **recip duration, e.g. '4I'). Read with the harm adapter (hamon convert --format harm); ~95% of labels map to HAMON Roman.

datasets.name: haydn-op20-harm
datasets.title: Haydn Op. 20 harmonic analyses (Nápoles López)
datasets.description: Roman-numeral harmonic analyses of Haydn's Op. 20 string quartets, aligned to scores. Custom 'harm' annotation format — a dedicated importer is pending (see notes).
datasets.citation: Nápoles López, N. (2017). Automatic harmonic analysis of Haydn's string quartets.
datasets.notes: Manual functional analysis as Humdrum **harm spines in .hrm files (Huron's harm syntax: letter inversions a/b/c/d, o/+ qualities, secondary /X). Auto-detected (.hrm → harm). ~98% of labels map to HAMON Roman; augmented sixths (Gn/It/Lt) and bracketed tonicizations stay text.

datasets.name: functional-harmony-bps
datasets.title: Functional Harmony Recognition (BPS-FH, Chen & Su)
datasets.description: Beethoven Piano Sonatas Functional Harmony (BPS-FH) and related corpora used for functional-harmony recognition. Analyses distributed as spreadsheets/CSV (chord, key, degree, quality, inversion).
datasets.citation: Chen, T.-P. & Su, L. (2018/2019). Functional harmony recognition with multi-task RNN / BPS-FH. ISMIR.
datasets.notes: Per-movement chords.xlsx (onset, offset, key, degree, quality, inversion, roman) → rn/degree layer with time positions and key→TonalRegion. Reading .xlsx needs hamonpy[bps] (pandas+openpyxl). Augmented-sixth chords (a6: It/Ger/Fr) are preserved as text — no HAMON Roman vocabulary yet.

datasets.name: mcgill-billboard
datasets.title: McGill Billboard chord annotations (DDMAL)
datasets.description: Expert chord transcriptions of a random sample of Billboard Hot 100 songs, in the SALAMI/Harte-style chord syntax. Harmony-only LAB/text annotations.
datasets.license: Research/academic use — see the DDMAL website
datasets.citation: Burgoyne, J.A., Wild, J. & Fujinaga, I. (2011). An Expert Ground Truth Set for Audio Chord Recognition and Music Analysis. ISMIR.

datasets.name: rock-corpus
datasets.title: Rock Corpus (Temperley & de Clercq)
datasets.description: Harmonic and melodic analyses of 200 rock songs (the RS 5x20 list). Roman-numeral harmonic analyses in a custom text format.
datasets.citation: de Clercq, T. & Temperley, D. (2011). A corpus analysis of rock harmony. Popular Music 30(1).
datasets.notes: Harmony analyses in the de Clercq-Temperley .har DSL (rules + $macros, |*N measure repeats, [tonic]/[timesig], % comments). Auto-detected (.har → rock_corpus). ~99% of chords map to HAMON Roman; sus/added-tone (Vs4, I#9) and flat-secondaries stay text.

datasets.name: kostka-payne
datasets.title: Kostka-Payne corpus (Temperley)
datasets.description: Harmonic analyses of the examples from Kostka & Payne's Tonal Harmony textbook, used in Temperley's harmonic-analysis work (chord-span and key labels).
datasets.citation: Temperley, D. (2009). A statistical analysis of tonal harmony (Kostka-Payne corpus).
datasets.notes: Root-level analysis: the kp-chord-list file gives, per chord span, the root as a chromatic interval above the key tonic plus the absolute key. Detected by filename (kp-chord-list*) or content. Each span → an upper-case Roman degree (no quality is recorded in the source), key → TonalRegion, onset → time Position.

datasets.name: dezrann-corpora
datasets.title: Dezrann annotated corpora (Algomus)
datasets.description: Time-aligned analytic annotations (cadences, patterns, harmony, structure) for the Dezrann platform, distributed as native .dez label files — directly read by HAMON's Dezrann adapter. See the 'rebuild' guide for how the corpora are assembled/regenerated.
datasets.citation: Giraud, M. et al. Dezrann: a web framework for distant reading of music scores. TISMIR. https://doi.org/10.5334/tismir.212
datasets.notes: Corpora are rebuilt per the doc.dezrann.net/rebuild guide (sources span several repos); no single archive URL — follow the rebuild guide, then point the Dezrann adapter at the resulting .dez files.

datasets.name: choro
datasets.title: Choro Songbook Corpus — DCML
datasets.description: Harmony and musical form of Brazilian choro (Choro Songbook, 3 vols.). Each chord is given in three encodings (absolute 'chord', Roman 'rn_chord', Harte 'harte') in a merged choro.tsv, plus per-piece form-grammar transcriptions (phrases/parts/song). HAMON reads both via its choro adapter — see the corpus-audit use case (use-cases/choro/).
datasets.citation: Moss, F. C., Souza, W. F., & Rohrmeier, M. Choro Songbook Corpus. DCMLab. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21219604
